name: crunchbase-mcp-skills
description: Reusable skills for researching companies, analyzing markets, and managing Crunchbase workflows.

interface.longDescription: Research companies and markets with Crunchbase. Build market maps, screen funding, prepare company briefs, analyze capital, and manage saved lists. Use Account Brief, Account Signals, Prospect Finder, Account Prioritizer, and Industry Insights for sales workflows.
defaultPrompt: Prepare a Crunchbase company brief for my next meeting.
Build a Crunchbase market landscape using my criteria.
Help me manage my Crunchbase saved lists.
